notes.text: Umar ibn al-Khattab, simply known as Umar, was the second Rashidun caliph, ruling from August 634 until his assassination in 644.
Umar succeeded Abu Bakr and is regarded as a senior companion and father-in-law of the Islamic prophet Muhammad.
Umar is remembered as a politician connected with Saudi Arabia.
Umar's recorded life dates place this profile around 585-644.
Umar is grouped with Justice, Governance & Leadership in the People Library.
